description: This is the main React component file for the IntelliMock platform's frontend. It defines the top-level App component, along with HeaderBar and MainContent, which structure the layout of the application including header branding and placeholder sections for future features.

methods.name: HeaderBar()
methods.description: Renders the header bar containing the brand logo, tagline, and stylized arrow graphic.

methods.name: MainContent()
methods.description: Provides placeholder sections for the main content area, including future widget areas.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Root component that composes HeaderBar and MainContent into the overall application layout.
